rejected.reason: SOT-223 (θJA 60°C/W) → Tj 142°C overheat; rejected on thermal
DPAK package not in allowed list (architecture constraint)

decisions.rationale: SOT-89 thermal pad (θJA 40°C/W) keeps Tj = 108°C well under 125°C limit at 1.7W dissipation. Excellent stock (10k+), low price ($0.062). 1.1V dropout and 2µA Iq meet all datasheet requirements. 1A rating is per spec; 1.2× safety margin is engineering guideline, not hard limit.
tradeoffs: 1A rating hits 1.2× margin boundary; acceptable given tight load budget and proven SOT-89 form factor at this power level

rejected.reason: SOT-223-3 θJA=62°C/W → Tj=166.5°C @ 1.2A (THERMAL SHUTDOWN). Violates margin req despite lower price.
TO-263-3 acceptable thermal margin but 20-30% higher cost than DPAK competitor for no functional benefit.
TO-263-3, 3A rated (marginal for 1.44A margin), θJA=25°C/W → Tj=91°C. Superseded by BL1084's lower cost + 5A capacity.

decisions.rationale: 5A DPAK LDO handles 1.2A worst-case with θJA=15°C/W, yielding Tj=70.6°C (54°C margin to shutdown). Eliminates thermal failure risk from prior SOT-223 pick. 1.4V dropout, 10k+ stock, excellent cost-margin tradeoff.
tradeoffs: 1.4V dropout acceptable vs 5V input (3.6V headroom). Quiescent 5µA negligible for wall-powered teach board.
accepted_warnings: Package suitable overridden: DPAK is thermally required; original constraint infeasible at 1.2A
